title: 第1156章 共治1第1155章 叩渊者
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
第1156章共治1
渊归队的消息沿三网枢纽航道传回东海时。
三界正好迎来开春的第一场雨。
雨丝细密绵长。
把安置区的桂花林洗得翠绿发亮。
联合学院大讲堂穹顶上那面桂枝环绕的“在”字旗被雨水打湿。
沉沉地垂在旗杆上。
偶尔被海风吹起一角，又缓缓落下。
沈无名站在议事殿侧厅的灵图前。
把渊通过跨网频道发来的叩渊者信标阵列完整星图逐层放大。
星图覆盖范围远超之前所有已知测绘区域的总和。
叩渊者在亘古前替三界做了一道封印外壳之后。
把残存的信标阵列改造成了域外深空探测网络。
一边叩击一边测绘，积累了海量的未探明星域数据。
这些数据现在全部无条件移交给三网枢纽协议。
作为叩渊者与三界共建者身份互认的第一份礼物。
秦岳在守远号舰桥上同步接收星图数据。
舰载叩应器的感应屏被密密麻麻的星体坐标、矿脉分布图和航道衰减曲线铺满。
他在逐帧核对这些数据时发现了一个极其醒目的特征。
叩渊者在亘古岁月中不仅测绘了已知星域。

还把许多未探明星域中发现的异常共振信号全部标注了详细特征。
绝大多数异常已由叩渊者自行复核确认为天然共振矿脉或惰性天体。
唯独有一组异常信号被叩渊者以极古老极郑重的共振语言单独加密封存。
标注日期是亘古前贯穿打击之后不久。
标注只有极简极短的一句。
“此叩击非吾等所发。来源更远，深度远超吾等探测极限。叩击结构极复杂极精密，疑为另一域外文明所发。吾等无力追踪，留待后来。”
秦岳把这组加密信号单独提取出来逐层拆解。
发现叩击的底层编码逻辑与建造者信标主频存在一个极细微的动态偏移。
偏移幅度以极精密的节奏周期性波动。
每次波动都携带一组独立的信息片段。
他把这些信息片段逐帧重组。
译码完成之后靠在椅背上沉默了好一会儿。
然后拿起叩应器朝舰桥广播。
“叩渊者亘古前收到的这组信号，解码后不是问候，不是信标，不是任何已知的共振语言——是一整套极其复杂的星图。星图标注的位置不在虚空之海，也不在叩渊者原生星域，而是在更远更深的域外空域。星图末尾附了一句话——‘吾等已知贯穿一击。天道根基应力释放之策，确为当时唯一可行之法。叩渊者牺牲原生星域，换正一世界天道根基完整，此为至善。吾等将此星图赠予叩渊者，若正一世界后继文明沿叩渊者信标寻至此处，可将此星图转赠。吾等名——渊墟。渊为深，墟为旧。吾等在此，叩以待复。’”
content_en:
Chapter 1156 Co-governance 1
When the news of Yuan's return to the team spread back to the East China Sea along the three-network hub channel.
The Three Realms are ushering in the first rain of spring.
The raindrops are thick and long.
The sweet-scented osmanthus forest in the resettlement area was washed green and shiny.
The "Zai" flag surrounded by cassia branches on the dome of the lecture hall of United College was soaked by the rain.
Hanging heavily on the flagpole.
Occasionally, a corner is blown up by the sea breeze, and then slowly falls down.
Shen Wuming stood in front of the spiritual picture in the side hall of the meeting hall.
Enlarge the complete star map of the Abyss beacon array sent by Yuan through the cross-network channel layer by layer.
The star map covers an area far greater than all previously known mapped areas combined.
After the Knocker made a sealing shell for the Three Realms in eternity.
The remaining beacon arrays were transformed into an extraterritorial deep space exploration network.
While tapping and mapping at the same time, a massive amount of data on unexplored star fields has been accumulated.
These data are now all unconditionally handed over to the Triple Network Hub Agreement.
As the first gift for mutual recognition of identities between those who knock on the abyss and those who co-constructed the Three Realms.
Qin Yue simultaneously received star chart data on the bridge of the Shouyuan.
The sensing screen of the ship-based tapper is covered with dense star coordinates, mineral vein distribution maps and channel attenuation curves.
When he checked the data frame by frame, he discovered an extremely striking feature.
The Knockers have not only surveyed and mapped the known star fields throughout the ages.
The detailed characteristics of all abnormal resonance signals found in many unexplored star fields have also been marked.
Most of the anomalies have been verified by the diggers themselves as natural resonance veins or inert celestial bodies.
Only one set of abnormal signals was individually sealed and stored by the Knockers in an extremely ancient and solemn resonance language.
The date is shortly after the Eternal Strike.
The annotation is only a very simple and short sentence.
"This knock was not sent by us. The source is farther away, and the depth is far beyond our detection limit. The structure of the knock is extremely complex and precise, and it is suspected to have been sent by another extraterrestrial civilization. We are unable to trace it, and we will leave it to later."
Qin Yue extracted this set of encrypted signals individually and disassembled them layer by layer.
It was found that there is a very slight dynamic offset between the underlying coding logic of the tap and the main frequency of the builder beacon.
The amplitude of the offset fluctuates periodically in an extremely precise rhythm.
Each fluctuation carries a separate set of pieces of information.
He reconstructed these pieces of information frame by frame.
After the decoding was completed, he leaned back in his chair and was silent for a while.
Then he picked up the clicker and broadcast to the bridge.
"This set of signals received by the Knockers in the Abyss in ancient times, after decoding, is not a greeting, a beacon, or any known resonance language - it is a set of extremely complex star maps. The location marked on the star map is not in the sea of ​​void, nor in the native star field of the Knockers, but in the farther and deeper outer space. At the end of the star map is a sentence - 'We know that there is a piercing blow. The way of heaven. The strategy of releasing the foundation stress is indeed the only feasible method at that time. It is the best thing for the people of Kouyuan to sacrifice the original star field to restore the integrity of the world. If the successor civilization of Kouyuan finds this place, it can be given to us. The abyss is deep and the ruins are old. We are here to wait for recovery.
